name: National Equipment Co
old_description: National Equipment is the only locally owned and leading foodservice equipment and suppliers in West Virginia. We have been serving the region for 80 years! No job is too large or complicated for our team. When you come into one of our showrooms, you will be received by our courteous and knowledgeable staff. Our sales team and technicians are on the road every day to keep your business running smoothly.
about:
National Equipment Company operates showrooms in Wheeling and Morgantown, West Virginia. The locally owned distributor has served the region’s foodservice industry for over 80 years, though a precise founding year is not publicly disclosed. The business began as a supplier of commercial kitchen equipment and has remained under local ownership.

The company distributes a broad range of foodservice equipment and smallwares, carrying brands such as Browne Foodservice and TableCraft Products. Its services extend beyond sales to include on-site installation oversight, equipment testing, and ongoing maintenance for walk-in coolers, commercial refrigeration, cooking equipment, exhaust fans, steamers, ice makers, dishwashers, slicers, mixers, and countertop units. Technicians on staff hold a combined 80 years of experience in installation and service. Emergency repair service is offered on weekends.

Customers span restaurants, bars, concession stands, institutional kitchens, and other foodservice operations throughout West Virginia. Product categories cover beverage and bar supplies, chef apparel, cleaning and facility products, cooking equipment, dishwashing equipment, disposables, food display, food preparation, furniture, ice machines, plumbing, refrigeration, smallwares, storage, and tabletop items.

National Equipment emphasizes its status as the only locally owned supplier in the state, with technicians who oversee every installation and provide weekend emergency support. The company’s showrooms allow hands-on product evaluation, and its sales and service teams travel daily to keep client operations running.

name: National Food Equipment & Supplies
old_description: We are the authorized distributor for Southeastern Michigan Since 1989. Mettler-Toledo specializes in weighing and networking printing scales, automatic meat wrapping and labeling equipment along with price computing scales. Call us for your specific application and we can provide the right solution for your unique store application including gourmet food markets, supermarkets, bakeries and delicatessens.
about:
National Food Equipment & Supplies (NFE) operates from Commerce Township, Michigan. The company traces its roots to 1963 when it began as a single-line equipment distributor. Now in its second generation of family ownership, NFE has expanded into a full-service commercial food equipment supplier and consultant serving Southeastern Michigan.

NFE provides kitchen layout and design services, producing CAD drawings that include equipment schedules, electrical and plumbing specifications. The firm also assists with Department of Health or Agriculture applications and manages equipment receiving, staging, delivery, and set-in-place installation. As an authorized distributor for brands such as Mettler-Toledo — offering weighing scales, labeling systems, and price-computing scales — NFE represents both major and niche equipment lines to match customer budgets and requirements.

The company serves restaurants, bars, specialty gourmet food markets, supermarkets, bakeries, delicatessens, institutions, and catering facilities. Its project experience spans new builds and remodels for independent operators and multi-unit chains alike.

NFE emphasizes customer service, integrity, and timely, cost-effective project completion. The firm’s differentiator lies in combining design expertise with a broad product portfolio, allowing it to act as a single point of contact from concept through installation.

name: National Seating & Mobility
old_description: No matter your mobility need, we have innovative products and a reliable team of experts to keep you moving so you can enjoy life to the fullest- whatever it takes.
about:
National Seating & Mobility operates a branch at 625 Broadway, Unit C in Bangor, Maine. The location functions as a local outlet for the national provider of mobility and accessibility equipment, identified as Branch ID 162. The company does not disclose a founding year or ownership structure for this specific branch.

The Bangor branch provides custom accessible wheelchairs, stairlifts, and ramps, along with power and manual wheelchairs, cushions, and custom-molded seating components. Services include remote evaluations and on-site service and repair. The team works within the complex rehab technology space, configuring wheelchairs and seating systems to individual clinical specifications. The company states it searches hundreds of component sources to assemble each custom chair.

The branch serves individuals with mobility impairments, their families and caregivers, as well as referring physicians and therapists. It operates within the medical supplies and complex rehab technology industries. Payment is accepted from a wide range of payer sources, including Medicaid and Medicare.

National Seating & Mobility differentiates itself by employing Rehab Technology Suppliers certified by the National Registry of Rehabilitation Technology Suppliers (NRRTS) and the Rehabilitation Engineering and Assistive Technology Society of North America (RESNA). The organization holds Joint Commission accreditation and emphasizes a client-centered approach, describing its mission as honoring each person’s journey toward independence.

name: National Solar
old_description: Choosing a solar warranty is really about choosing who stands behind your system. National Solar is a woman-owned, Bend-based company with a high Energy Trust of Oregon rating and an award-winning team that has designed and installed every system with care since 2009.
about:
National Solar was founded in 2009 in Bend, Oregon, by Janelle Lancaster, who serves as president. The woman-owned, Oregon-based company began as a local solar installer committed to keeping design, installation, and service under one roof rather than handing projects off to subcontractors.

The firm designs, installs, and services residential solar photovoltaic systems, battery storage (primarily Enphase), and EV charging equipment across Oregon. All work is performed by its own crews, from permitting and utility paperwork through final inspection. The company also troubleshoots, repairs, and removes existing systems, including those it did not originally install, and backs installations with a 10-year workmanship warranty and 25-year panel coverage.

National Solar serves Oregon homeowners, including landlords adding solar to rental properties, and works with the state's major utilities — Pacific Power, Portland General Electric, Eugene Water & Electric, and numerous electric cooperatives — to process Energy Trust of Oregon incentives. Its service territory spans from Central Oregon to the coast.

Lancaster started the business to provide a single point of accountability for the life of a system: the same team that designs a project installs and maintains it, with no call centers and no service-call fees during the warranty period. The approach has earned the company a high Energy Trust of Oregon rating and three consecutive Best Solar Service Company awards from the Bend community.

name: National Woodwork Mfg.
old_description: For more than 30 years we have provided quality products to commercial and residential clients.  Our cabinetry and millwork add value to our clients' projects at competitive prices.  we also strive to meet all delivery schedules.
about:
National Woodwork Mfg. was established in 1985 in Bethlehem, Pennsylvania, as a privately held family business. The company began with a focus on custom cabinetry and architectural millwork, serving commercial, institutional, and residential clients across the Mid-Atlantic region.

The shop produces custom architectural millwork, commercial casework, cabinetry, wall panel systems, reception desks, fixtures, and specialty wood products. Capabilities include CNC machining, edge banding, and precision cutting on equipment such as a Tectra 6120 classic horizontal beam saw and an Atlas Copco compressor. The facility houses both traditional woodworking craftsmanship and modern computerized equipment.

The company serves architects, contractors, designers, and business owners in sectors including healthcare, education, hospitality, retail, government, and commercial office space. Projects have been delivered throughout Pennsylvania, Maryland, Delaware, New Jersey, Virginia, Washington, D.C., and surrounding areas, with notable installations in schools, libraries, museums, and hotels.

National Woodwork Mfg. emphasizes skilled craftsmanship combined with continuous equipment upgrades to maintain quality, competitive pricing, and timely delivery. The firm has earned the AWI Award of Excellence and was named one of the top 100 fastest-growing millwork companies in North America for eight consecutive years by Wood & Wood Products magazine.

about:
Native Energy Solutions, LLC is headquartered in Casper, Wyoming. The company was formed by a group of experienced businessmen with deep backgrounds in oil and gas services and construction. While the exact founding year is not publicly disclosed, the firm has established field offices across the Permian, Bakken, and Powder River basins to serve clients regionally.

The company operates as an automation and electrical integrator, offering UL-listed panel fabrication, transmission and distribution services, electrical construction, automation and programming, and communications/SCADA integration. Its teams handle projects ranging from control panel builds to full-scale system integration for industrial facilities.

Native Energy Solutions primarily serves the oil and gas and industrial sectors across Montana, New Mexico, North Dakota, Texas, Wyoming, Oklahoma, and Colorado. Its client base includes operators in major basins such as the Permian, Bakken, and Powder River, where the company maintains a local presence for rapid response.

The firm emphasizes a culture of quality, safety, and customer-focused service, aiming to be recognized as a high-performance, responsive integrator and a preferred vendor. Its leadership team includes CEO Ryan Senderhauf, CFO Ben Williamson, and vice presidents Chad Clay, Joey Ackman, Justin Drake, and Ryan Rodgers, the latter two also serving as master electricians.

about:
Native Solar is based in Meridian, Idaho, and operates across Idaho, Montana, and Oregon. The company was founded by Dylan Davis, an Idaho native who has worked in in-home sales since 2009. Davis, a serial entrepreneur who also owns Native Sauna, Home Service Pros, and Native Apparel, established Native Solar as a locally owned sales organization focused on helping customers take ownership of their power.

Native Solar functions as a sales and design firm rather than an installer. The team evaluates a customer’s power consumption and designs a custom solar system for each home or business, using only products. The company does not install systems itself; instead, it contracts with a network of local installers to execute the projects, coordinating the process from design through installation.

The company serves residential and commercial customers in the three-state region, with a focus on home solar energy and net energy metering arrangements. Its customer base includes homeowners and businesses looking to reduce utility costs and gain energy independence.

Native Solar differentiates itself by emphasizing its local roots—its founders and staff live in the communities they serve—and by leveraging multiple installer partnerships to secure competitive pricing. A referral program pays customers up to $500 for each referral, and the company stresses a family‑oriented service mentality.

name: Nautilus Cables
old_description: Dynamic Cable Design and Manufacturing for Challenging Applications
about:
Nautilus Cables was founded in 1998 in Rosenberg, Texas, by Bob Conners, who remains the owner. The company began as a specialist in dynamic cable design and manufacturing for challenging applications, with a focus on defense and government sectors.

Operating from its facility on Anton Stade Road, Nautilus provides turnkey cable and umbilical solutions encompassing consultation, engineering (design-to-build or build-to-suit), testing, manufacturing, and on-site installation. The company produces ruggedized optical cables, tow cables for marine, hydrographic, defense, and seismic applications, electro-mechanical and electro-optic cables, and high-strength small-diameter communication cables, as well as buoyant, non-buoyant, and hybrid configurations.

Nautilus serves the defense industry, including the Department of Defense, U.S. Armed Forces, and Homeland Security, along with marine, hydrographic, seismic, and surveillance sectors. The company also works with affiliates SeisGEar, Inc. and EnP Industries, LLC.

The firm differentiates itself through NIST 800-171 compliance, which streamlines work on critical defense projects, and by modeling cable performance at the front end to reduce development time. It emphasizes personalized service, immediate manufacturing ramp-up for quick turns, and on-site expert installation.

Nebraska Scooter Mart LLC opened in January 2004 in Lincoln, Nebraska, as a locally owned medical equipment store. Since its founding, the business has served the Lincoln area as a dedicated provider of mobility assistive equipment, building a reputation for consistent local presence.

The company operates as a medical equipment retailer, offering a selection that includes hospital beds and related products, as well as bath safety products and other mobility assistive devices. In addition to sales, the firm maintains a staff of service technicians who perform equipment repair and maintenance, supporting the products they sell through both in-shop and on-site service.

The customer base encompasses individuals requiring mobility assistance as well as healthcare providers and facilities that need reliable medical equipment. The company’s product focus on hospital beds and bath safety items aligns with the needs of home care and institutional settings, and its technicians work directly with clients to ensure proper equipment fit and function.

Nebraska Scooter Mart distinguishes itself as the longest-tenured locally owned medical equipment store in Lincoln. The company also points to its team of dedicated professionals, who collectively hold an average of 20 years of experience in the field of mobility assistive equipment, as a key reason customers rely on their expertise for both product selection and ongoing support.
